record.segment: Public research university; 15,000–20,000 enrollment band; Jonesboro, Arkansas
facts_carried_over: Tracy Finch is listed as Registrar; the Registrar’s Office owns registration, grading, academic records, FERPA compliance, course evaluations, and academic/classroom scheduling (Arkansas State University Registrar page, accessed 2026-09-03).
Fall 2025 11th-day enrollment was 17,926 (Arkansas State University news release, 2025-09-05).
A-State uses Canvas; live Canvas shells are created by ITS from Banner course enrollments (A-State Knowledge Base, accessed 2026-09-03; course-identification page updated approximately 2025-09).

Canvas course-access reports expose defined participation events, and A-State publishes Roll Call Attendance reporting instructions with course, SIS course, student, date, status, and timestamp fields (A-State Knowledge Base, accessed 2026-09-03).

For never-attended grading, faculty determine WN status; for web classes, a WN is available only when the student never logged into Canvas. The Registrar handles correction instructions and reinstatement documentation (Arkansas State University Register, Add, or Drop page, accessed 2026-09-03).

A-State’s official census occurs on the 11th class day in fall and spring and the 5th class day in summer; census data support official reporting, financial aid, and accreditor reporting (Arkansas State University Institutional Data and Analytics page, accessed 2026-09-03).
Apollo lists Christina Kostick as Director of Financial Aid, refreshed 2026-08-08; Chris Boothman as CIO, refreshed 2026-08-22; Tracy Finch as Registrar, refreshed 2026-08-12.
